personality.summary: An obsessive artist who treats everything, including battle and bodies, as material for art; when blocked from her desired subject she becomes lethally impatient.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Obsessed with painting his nude body and later creates combat copies of him, including Ittou Shura users.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Romantic rival nuisance; bribes Stella with a promised royal wedding portrait to gain access to Ikki as a model.
relationships.kurashiki-kurando: Second-round opponent; she dismisses him as an obstacle and defeats him with copied Ikkis.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Akatsuki teammate who earlier warned Ikki not to underestimate Sara.

periods.summary: Sara intrudes into Ikki's hotel room through a drawn door in the wall to demand he pose nude, revealing that her public artist identity is the famous Mario Rosso. Stella initially defends Ikki but is almost bribed by Sara's offer to paint a royal wedding portrait. In the C-block second round Sara reveals the full scale of her abilities. Beyond color concepts such as water, flame, guidance and steel, her Demiurge Brush can actualize drawings as weapons, missiles, armies and even Blazer copies. Kurando's new skill forces her to escalate, but she ultimately draws Ikki copies using Ittou Shura; when Kurando destroys one, more copies impale him. The match proves Sara is far above her nominal C rank, likely A-class in combat value, and creates severe pressure for Ikki's same-day tournament path.

key_events.summary: Interrupts Ikki and Stella by demanding Ikki become her nude model.
Defeats Kurando using Color Magic, Phantasmal Caricature and copied Ikkis.
